children: Klepierre is expected to remain selective with future acquisitions to secure the quality of its portfolio, Berenberg analyst Kai Klose says in a research note. "Klepierre's strong financial profile has enabled it to be well ahead of non-listed investors in sourcing acquisitions," Klose says. The French shopping-center operator is expected to remain selective on acquisitions, while the increase of deals in the investment market provides at least some visibility on transaction values, Klose says. The operator's around 600 million euro capital-expenditure pipeline also further underlines its earnings momentum, Klose adds. Shares trade 0.4% higher at 37.62 euros. (nina.kienle@wsj.com)
